title: Return Noble USDC escrow to the migration multisig and freeze the Coreum USDC voucher
summary: Circle ends USDC support on Noble; the full pause is on 2027-01-12. This proposal returns Noble's full USDC escrow for Coreum (55,000.337630 USDC, Noble channel-49) to the multisig noble1REPLACE_WITH_MULTISIG over channel-19 (MsgReturnToNoble with that explicit amount), covering all Noble USDC vouchers (ibc/E1E3674A0E4E1EF9C69646F9AF8D9497173821826074622D831BAB73CCB99A2D) still in circulation on Coreum. In the same execution it disables bank sends of the voucher, so the holder snapshot is the height emitted by the usdcmigration_return_to_noble event. Holders are repaid off-chain from that snapshot: REPLACE_WITH_REPAYMENT_PLAN_URL.
